headline: V26-3845: make the live view's Now page say where a delivery stands, and stop four lead-command frictions

V26-3819.title: Lead the live view's Now page with one sentence, four marks and one fact, at every stage of a delivery

criteria.text: Each of the 12 stages and 3 overrides renders the canvas's sentence shape, marks and fact from a fixture record, with the live mark's holder taken from the record.
During the rejoin, Now never names an item as holding up the finish unless it holds the close and its holder can act on it. A tracker lag alone renders no Now sentence or fact.
A change request waiting on a merge renders its link and "waits for your merge". A failing forge check renders as the fact, saying whether the target fails it too.
The hosted view renders the same Now as the local view for each fixture.
No page text names a repository-specific check, branch or command. Checked in a rendered view against kwam1na/athena#488 and the canvas, light and dark, at 375px.

V26-3844.title: Stop the supervisor's lane-changes step failing on non-UTF-8 output

criteria.text: With a lane branch whose diff or listing carries a file name that isn't valid UTF-8, the step completes and reports its branches. The odd name is shown with replacement characters.
Today's output for UTF-8 names is unchanged.

V26-3841.title: Let lead-setup --integration run beside untracked files it never reads

criteria.text: Setup succeeds with an untracked file outside the paths it writes, names it in its output, and leaves it untouched.
Setup still refuses a modified tracked file, and an untracked file at a path it would write.

V26-3436.title: Drop a resolved queue stop from the supervisor's status line once the candidate is requeued

criteria.text: After a requeue journals check.started for the candidate, the status line no longer names its earlier stop, and a test holds that.

V26-3843.title: Say, in every lead command, that a broken base holds the queue until a repair is named

criteria.text: With a base.broken standing, each of those commands prints the hold and the repair command. Without one, their output is unchanged.
Accepting with the repair option queues the candidate as the repair, which the queue takes first and alone.

finish.label: The stories
finish.text: V26-3819, V26-3844, V26-3841, V26-3436 and V26-3843 land on integrate/now-page-and-lead-fixes through its merge queue, each with every criterion met

finish.label: Local suite
finish.text: The full local suite passes on macOS with Python 3.11 at the integration head, with --workers 4 --budget tests/suite-budget.json

finish.label: Into main
finish.text: The integration base is reviewed for main, as the orchestrate-work guide's integration review says, and merged into main
